title: helichrysum cuneifolium
intro: Helichrysum cuneifolium, commonly known as yellow everlasting, is a flowering plant in the daisy family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation, improve circulation, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Helichrysum cuneifolium include wound healing, anti-infective, and anti-inflammatory effects, which may aid in the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
